name: smart-village-telehealth
description: Smart Village Digital Tele-Health Dispensary Dashboard with Low-Bandwidth Video Failovers

scripts.build: vite build && rollup app.js --file dist-bundle.js --format iife --name VillageMed --globals react:React,react-dom/client:ReactDOM && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.copyFileSync('dist-bundle.js', 'dist/dist-bundle.js'))"
scripts.bundle: rollup app.js --file dist-bundle.js --format iife --name VillageMed --globals react:React,react-dom/client:ReactDOM
scripts.test: node consultationChat.test.js && node authStateGuard.test.js && node crossDeviceCommunication.test.js && node smartQueueAllocation.test.js && node fullWorkflowVerification.test.js && node consultationSlotSelection.test.js
